timingDefinition.messageRoundTripMs: Page performance.now immediately before postMessage until the result event; includes worker startup on fresh workers, hashing/loading/inference, progress messaging and report transfer; excludes browser launch, server startup, page creation and UI rendering.
timingDefinition.diagnostics: Worker-reported integer milliseconds. durationMs starts inside the run handler; assetLoadMs includes downloading/cache reads and SHA-256 checks; modelLoadMs covers tokenizer/model initialization; inferenceMs covers tokenization and embedding.
timingDefinition.cold: Five fresh isolated browser contexts with empty public-asset CacheStorage. A shared browser process, local loopback server and OS disk/code caches are not flushed; this is context/model cold, not cold OS disk.
timingDefinition.cached: Five fresh pages/workers using the six verified public assets saved by their paired cold contexts; model initialization still occurs.
timingDefinition.warm: Ten audits in one already initialized worker following its cached fresh-worker run; no samples discarded.
timingDefinition.transfer: Loopback asset transfer is not a public-network download-speed measurement. Downloaded bytes come from each worker diagnostic.

limitations: Synthetic author-defined labels are not representative production data or commercial validation.
The score policy is unchanged and advisory; accepted matches can be unsafe or wrong.
Single installed Chromium-family browser on one coarse OS/architecture; no physical mobile, Safari or Firefox timing.
Timing samples share a browser process and loopback server; no claims about public-hosting latency, cold disk or memory.
